scope: Intact N-glycopeptides were enriched by Zic-HILIC materials.
200 ·g of tryptic peptides were dissolved in 70% ACN/0.2% TFA solution, added into the processed Zic-HILIC beads and rotated for 2 h at 37°C to enrich the intact N-glycopeptides.
Intact N-glycopeptides bound on the Zic-HILIC beads were eluted three times with 70 ·l of 0.1% TFA. The pooled eluent was dried under vacuum for subsequent LC-MS/MS analysis.
